matter_background.original: In 1978 March Nimal Perera had purchased a land in extent of 26 Perches situated in Kohuwala for Rs.120,000/- and constructed a house on it. The cost of construction of the house was Rs. 2,900,000/- He wishes to gift this house and land to his son Aruna and instructs you to prepare a Deed of Gift. The present market value of the house and property is Rs.5,700,000/-
